name: BACH_0107_FSIM_stain3
markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Invasive (99%)** · Confident · Careful review
Tier 1 simulated frozen section calls all four margins positive [F7], while 3/5 similar cases are InSitu (stains blocked).

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Top probabilities | Invasive 99%, InSitu 1%, Benign 0%, Normal 0% [F1] | Strong separation for Invasive |
| Conformal set | {Invasive} at 90% target (90% test coverage, n=132) | Single class at 90% guarantee |
| Reliability / OOD | 98% reliability, 92nd percentile OOD, 12/12 regions [F6] | Unflagged, high OOD from stain |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | True (same top class) | Independent foundation models agree |
| Similar cases | 40% match (2/5 Invasive, 3/5 InSitu) [F5] | Split between Invasive and InSitu |

## Tissue evidence
- **Dense lymphocytic infiltrate (TILs)** (region 3) · context · Below-typical score (-0.72 SD, +0.421 contribution) [F2] · Weak
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (region 8) · ↑ invasive · Above-typical infiltration (+0.85 SD, +0.363 contribution) [F3] · Validated
- **Gland / tubule formation** (region 11) · ↑ invasive · Scarce tubules (-0.80 SD, +0.359), caption inconsistent [F4] · Weak
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (region 11) · ↓ invasive · Above-typical stroma (+0.71 SD, -0.195 contribution) · Validated

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful; removing top 3 risk regions beats random (+0.0114 drop, 95% CI 0.0021–0.0197, n=132).
- **Concepts**: Unverified (deletion CI -0.0088–0.0064 includes 0); mitoses (0/20), normal lobules (0/20), and necrosis (3/20) are unreliable.

## Could be wrong if
- High-grade InSitu mimics invasion; 3/5 similar cases are InSitu (BACH_0155 at 82%), and necrosis is unreliable (3/20).
- Severity-3 simulated frozen-section stain degradation (92nd OOD percentile) distorts features (test ECE 5%, reliability AUROC 70%).

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 8, 4, 1**: Confirm stromal invasion (98%–100% risk); disregard unreliable mitoses score in region 8.
2. **Regions 3, 9, 11**: Check duct confinement (region 3), stroma/tubules (region 11), and pleomorphism vs InSitu.
3. **Regions 0–4, 7–11**: Verify positive margin calls (inferior 753, medial 538, superior 430, lateral 215 um).
